promo-flatten-trap.title: The Canva checkbox that kills every link #shorts
promo-flatten-trap.description: Flatten PDF sounds like housekeeping. It bakes every layer into a flat image and strips every hyperlink out of the document - sponsor links, product links, your whole contents page. And the file still looks perfect. Full digital magazine tutorial on the channel.

promo-contents-jump.title: Make a Canva contents page that actually jumps #shorts
promo-contents-jump.description: Select the line, hit Link, choose "Pages in this document" - the option almost nobody uses. One thumb navigates a 40-page magazine. But links die on text with an effect applied. Full digital magazine tutorial on the channel.
